cohort.selection_gate: Retain only if historical SupGP source/RMS and usable 28-day coverage pass Stage-1B ingestion audit
cohort.orbital_scope: single narrow project shell: inclination about 53.16 deg; mean-altitude proxy 472.5-474.6 km

rationale: contains the project formal TLE/pass epoch 2026-03-10
contains the successful Stage-0 historical SupGP interval 2026-03-08 through 2026-03-14
overlaps existing ordinary GP caches without claiming full 28-day local coverage
keeps possible regime changes for independent labeling instead of selecting them away

celestrak.estimate_basis: Stage-0 observed 19 SupGP records in 7 days per satellite, scaled by 4; not a guaranteed count

space_track.lookback_basis: Stage-0 max selected gp_age was 27.03 h; 72 h is >2.6x that value and spans several typical update cycles

causal_policy.no_candidate_action: mark causal_missing; never select a future release

reference_sampling_policy.ordinary_gp: propagate selected causal record to evaluation_time
reference_sampling_policy.supgp: use at native epoch; if propagated, record supgp_propagation_age_seconds explicitly
reference_sampling_policy.reference_semantics: operator-derived higher-quality SGP4-compatible reference, not precise truth

framework.nominal-looking: no aligned multi-indicator discontinuity; adequate reference continuity
framework.possible_regime_change: at least two independent feature families show temporally aligned change
framework.uncertain: isolated/conflicting evidence or insufficient reference quality/coverage
framework.constraint: BSTAR jump alone never establishes a maneuver

regime_design.execution: deferred to Stage-1B; no formal labels trained or thresholded in Stage-1A

statistical_split_design.primary_nominal_outer_split: 12 train/development satellites, 3 calibration satellites, 3 held-out test satellites
statistical_split_design.controls: 65411 possible-regime and 65410 uncertain remain evaluation-only controls; do not train nominal boundary with them
statistical_split_design.assignment: after coverage audit, deterministic and stratified by cached/reference coverage and orbital proxy; freeze in manifest
statistical_split_design.temporal_rule: keep complete propagation arcs and adjacent same-day SupGP epochs in one partition

direct_spacex_ephemeris.policy: from pilot start, archive raw operator files and provenance for a small selected subset
